title: CPI inflation-by-category explainer (national, BLS)
context: Bureau of Labor Statistics CPI data is public domain, but the raw series tables are opaque to most readers. A plain-language explainer showing how inflation varies by spending category (food, shelter, energy, medical, etc.) helps consumers, journalists, and educators understand purchasing power changes — provided it carries an explicit 'not financial advice' notice and a correct base/reference period, and that the Methodology Card records the BLS series and limits.
objective: Build a CPI inflation-by-category explainer at the national level (BLS data), passing gate-003 and the methodology gate, with reproducible figures and a 'not financial advice' framing.
acceptanceCriteria: Gate-003 PASS: BLS = US government public domain; output text CC-BY-4.0; no PII; committed gate artifact.

Plain-language inflation-by-category explainer shows correct base/reference period and category breakdowns with explicit 'not financial advice' notice; Methodology Card records the BLS series, base period, transforms, and known limits.
Figures reproduce from committed code + BLS source snapshot in CI; built on the shared toolkit (toolkit-002).
Accessibility pass (WCAG 2.2 AA, reading grade <= 8) signed off.
License reviewer and Methodology+Stats reviewer sign-offs obtained.
resources: PLAN.md — Data, licensing & compliance (BLS CPI row)
output: A CPI inflation-by-category explainer (committed static tool + plain-language content + Methodology Card + gate artifact + accessibility sign-off).
